ProfileSet.description: Fields to set. A field absent here is left unchanged; `null` is not a value (use `reset`).
ProfileSet.title: ProfileSet

SessionInfo.description: A signed-in device, with safe metadata only (app/auth/devices.py).
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
The one PATCH shape (docs/api-contract.md): `set` replaces the listed fields, `reset`
returns fields to their defaults (both of these become empty), anything else is unchanged.
`version` must be the profileVersion the client read; otherwise 409 version_conflict.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up, and the release it runs

get.description:
The account's signed-in devices, most recently used first. Only a device label and a
masked network leave the server, never the raw IP address or user agent.

delete.description: Signs one other device out. The current device signs out with POST /v1/auth/logout.

post.summary: Send a message and wait for the whole reply
Send a message and stream the reply (Server-Sent Events)
Replace the last reply with a new one (Server-Sent Events)

patch.description: Superseded by PATCH /v1/me/profile, which is versioned; kept for existing clients.

get.description:
Content-addressed: cacheable forever only when `v` names the current photo. Any other
`v` (a replaced or removed photo) is a 404 that is never cached, so an old URL can never
be served new bytes.

put.description:
Upload a profile photo as the raw request body (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to
AVATAR_MAX_BYTES). It is stored as a 256 px WebP without metadata (app/auth/avatar.py).

post.description: Sends a code to the new address. Always 202, whether or not the address is free.
Moves the account to the new address and signs out every other device.

patch.description:
Versioned edit of the identity profile: `{version, set, reset}` (docs/api-contract.md).
A stale version answers 409 version_conflict with the current profile in `error.current`.
